[Council File 26-1321]
City Attorney report and draft Ordinance relative to amending the Los Angeles Municipal Code regarding the renewal of licenses to conduct commercial cannabis activity.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted

outcome.text: Public Works Committee action: Approved (Nov 10, 2026); Council action: Adopted (Nov 17, 2026)

summary: City Attorney draft ordinance changing how licenses to conduct commercial cannabis activity are renewed under the Municipal Code.
